title: Correct refractive index
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the numerical value √3 or its decimal equivalent 1.732.

title: Correct speed of light
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as c/√3, (√3/3)c, or its decimal equivalent 0.577c.

title: Geometry for angles
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the internal angles of the prism (∠B = 30°) and the angle of incidence on face AC (α = 60°).

title: Application of Snell's Law
description: Important: The refractive index must be derived by correctly applying Snell's Law (n = sin α / sin β) at the AC interface.

title: Symmetry and reversibility
description: Optional: The solution may note the symmetry of the path or use the principle of reversibility to deduce β = γ = 30°.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The answer for speed should maintain consistent units, showing it as a fraction of c.

title: Incorrect angle identification
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misidentifies the angle of incidence (α) or the refraction angle (β), leading to a wrong index.

title: Misapplication of Snell's Law
description: Pitfall: Penalize if Snell's Law is applied incorrectly, e.g., inverting the ratio of sines or applying it at the wrong interface.
